name.description: Built-in secret names such as youtube_stream_key are supported. Managed destinations and runtime profiles may also use scoped names such as youtube_stream_key_main, discord_bot_token_main, encoder_runtime_secret_main, google_drive_folder_id_main, webhook_url_main, or smtp_password_main. Raw values are never returned.

fingerprint.description: Non-secret fingerprint for change detection. Raw secret values are never returned.
